nodes.description: Constant cap of 15 NFTs per purchase in BlockchainBears.
Mutable maximum token supply (10000), used in supply checks and starting index modulus.
Sale price in wei (5e16), settable by owner via setPrice.
Boolean gate controlling whether mintBears can be executed.
Reveal starting index derived from blockhash, used for token metadata shuffling.
Block number recorded for later starting index computation.
Owner-controlled base URI string returned by _baseURI.
Mapping of tokenId to individual token URI.
onlyOwner function toggling saleIsActive.
onlyOwner function transferring the entire contract balance to msg.sender.
onlyOwner function minting 30 reserved tokens to msg.sender and recording startingIndexBlock.
onlyOwner function updating the mint price with a non-zero requirement.
Payable public mint function validating sale state, supply, caps and ETH value, then looping _safeMint.
onlyOwner function computing startingIndex from blockhash(startingIndexBlock) modulo MAX_SUPPLY.
onlyOwner fallback that sets startingIndexBlock to block.number.
Internal view returning the extended base URI.
onlyOwner function updating the base URI.
Overridden tokenURI combining base URI and per-token URI/id.
msg.sender, attacker-influenced caller used as recipient and publisher in mint/withdraw flows.
External ETH transfer payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance) in withdraw, restricted to owner.
_safeMint triggering external onERC721Received callback on recipient contract during minting.
Arithmetic price.mul(numberOfTokens) used to validate msg.value.
Arithmetic totalSupply().add(numberOfTokens) used to enforce MAX_SUPPLY.
Caller-supplied quantity of tokens to mint in mintBears.
New price value supplied to setPrice.
New base URI string supplied to setBaseURI.
Token identifier queried in tokenURI.
Local variable caching address(this).balance in withdraw.
Local variable caching totalSupply() in reserveTokens.
Loop counter used while minting tokens in mintBears.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the recipient passed to _safeMint inside mintBears.
msg.sender is the ETH receiver in withdraw, an untrusted input reaching privileged value transfer.
withdraw executes the balance transfer external call.
ETH is pushed to the untrusted msg.sender address via transfer in withdraw.
mintBears calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract.
reserveTokens calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract.
mintBears performs price.mul(numberOfTokens) to check msg.value.
mintBears performs totalSupply().add(numberOfTokens) to enforce MAX_SUPPLY.
numberOfTokens is the attacker-controlled operand of price.mul.
numberOfTokens is the attacker-controlled operand of totalSupply().add.
numberOfTokens governs the mintBears execution path and loop bounds.
price state variable is read as a factor in price.mul.
MAX_SUPPLY is the bound compared against totalSupply().add.
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive state variable.
saleIsActive is required to be true for mintBears to proceed.
setPrice, restricted by onlyOwner, writes the price state variable.
The _price parameter is assigned into the price state variable.
_price is the argument parameter of setPrice.
calcStartingIndex, onlyOwner, writes startingIndex derived from blockhash.
calcStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to derive the seed.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock, onlyOwner, writes startingIndexBlock from block.number.
setBaseURI, onlyOwner, writes the _baseURIExtended state variable.
The baseURI_ parameter is assigned into _baseURIExtended.
baseURI_ is the argument parameter of setBaseURI.
_baseURI returns the _baseURIExtended state variable.
tokenURI reads the per-token entry from the _tokenURIs mapping.
tokenURI calls _baseURI to obtain the base string.
tokenId parameter controls the tokenURI lookup path.
tokenId is used to index the _tokenURIs mapping.
The loop index i bounds the repeated _safeMint calls in mintBears.
The local balance value is the amount moved by the withdraw transfer.
The local supply index seeds the _safeMint loop in reserveTokens.

normalization_plan.reason: Attacker-controlled mint quantity is only meaningful within mintBears and should be normalized into that function node.
_price exists solely as the input to setPrice and should be merged into that function node.
baseURI_ is consumed only by setBaseURI and should be merged into that function node.
tokenId is used only for lookups inside tokenURI and should be merged into that function node.
The cached balance is the direct data source of the withdraw transfer unsafe_operation.
The cached supply counter only drives the reserveTokens minting loop.
The loop counter exists only to iterate the mintBears minting loop.
